source: Iced-Cream's own tests on their unit: VD4H on Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7, 2026-11-08, runs T209 F1/P1/P2/F2) and, before it, the core-ar2 0.6 unit test V6H4 (2026-10-23) of the same source
statement: Iced-Cream reports that on an Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74 and this package on Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7, plain variant ba530f45, with analoghealth 1.3 for remote keys), build VD4H, 2026-11-08: with DAC SUM off FILTER pressed twice stayed on stock's FILTER page; GLOBAL > AUDIO ROUTING showed the DAC SUM row and it turned ON; FILTER pressed twice then opened DAC FILTER; its knobs followed TYP (OFF: neither FRQ nor RES; LP2: both; LP1: FRQ only); BD's LP1 came back after SAVE KIT and KIT RELOAD; DAC SUM ON and BD's LP1 were kept across a hand power cycle with no save; DAC SUM went back OFF. CPU 74.5-74.9 % before any key and 82.8-82.9 % while playing with DAC SUM on and BD on LP2, heap flat. The owner listened to BD on LP2 at the lowest FRQ and on TYP OFF, turning TYP by hand, and reported: "sounds as expected". Earlier: Hardware, Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74, 2026-10-23, V6H4 (core-ar2 0.6 with all eleven rytm2_mods ports, voice-dac 1.4 among them, plus analoghealth for remote keys): with DAC SUM on, FILTER pressed twice opened DAC FILTER; TYP OFF showed TYP and DEP only with the empty knobs inert; LP2, BP, HP2, BS and PK showed FRQ and RES, LP1 and HP1 FRQ only; the page followed BD (LP1) to SD (OFF) and back; RES was kept across LP2, LP1 and LP2; BD on LP2, LP1 and OFF played without dropouts, checked by ear with no click or break; after SAVE KIT, a power cycle and RELOAD, DAC SUM was still ON and BD's LP1 setting came back. The other ten mods behaved as in v1.3.
scope: voice-dac 1.4.0 (this package) on Modwerk's base with analoghealth (VD4H); earlier voice-dac 1.4 beside the other ten rytm2_mods ports and analoghealth on core-ar2 0.6 (V6H4).

builds.label: VD4H
builds.content: stock 1.74 + Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 (plain variant ba530f45) + analoghealth 1.3 (c32aa50c, remote keys) + this package, linked by scripts/link-image.mjs. Flashed under elkbench plans after their emulator gate, stock 1.74 restored.
results: FILTER pressed twice with DAC SUM off stays on stock's FILTER page.
AUDIO ROUTING shows DAC SUM; it turns ON. FILTER pressed twice then opens DAC FILTER.
The knobs follow TYP: OFF hides FRQ and RES, LP2 shows both, LP1 shows FRQ only.
BD on LP1 comes back after SAVE KIT and KIT RELOAD, and DAC SUM ON and BD on LP1 survive a hand power cycle with no save.
CPU 74.5-74.9 % before keys, 82.8-82.9 % playing with DAC SUM on and BD on LP2; heap flat.
The owner listened (BD on LP2 at the lowest FRQ, then TYP OFF and back by hand): "sounds as expected".

builds.label: V6H4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.6 (6d5302f) with rytm2_mods' eleven OS 1.74 mods, voice-dac 1.4 built from 77bd329, plus analoghealth 1.2 for remote keys. Flashed by the owner, test steps run through remote keys and by hand, stock 1.74 restored.
results: DAC FILTER by TYP: OFF shows TYP and DEP only; LP1 and HP1 hide RES; the empty knobs are inert.
The page follows the track: BD (LP1) to SD (OFF) and back.
RES kept across LP2, LP1, LP2.
BD on LP2, LP1 and OFF: no dropouts; checked by ear, no click or break.
SAVE KIT, power cycle, RELOAD: DAC SUM still ON, BD back on LP1 at its saved FRQ.

limitations: VD4H: .syx d2b7c794741bd7846136046daa20e4b3f66d1e7608180e35306f1dba7209503a, built by scripts/link-image.mjs from this folder's package; firmware was not read back from the device.
VD4H also carried analoghealth 1.3 (remote keys; no site shared with this module).
Persistence checked for TYP (LP1) and DAC SUM only; FRQ, RES, DEP, ATK, SUS and POL, and TYP past LP1, were not checked on the unit.
The filter's effect on the sound was judged by ear only (no data read or recording); duration was not recorded.
Core-ar2 0.6, not Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7); this package has not been flashed.
V6H4's voice-dac object was built from 77bd329 before the v1.4 release; its source equals v1.4's, but its bytes were not compared with the v1.4 release object.
Duration was not recorded; firmware was not read back from the device.
No v1.3 reference recording, so the sound was not compared with an earlier version.
